nodes.name: Validate & Normalize
nodes.notes: Sanitizes input, rejects invalid leads, normalizes budget / size / timeline. AI never guesses missing data.

nodes.name: Prepare AI Input
nodes.notes: Computes the deterministic rule score and builds the Gemini request. Lead data is wrapped as untrusted data.

nodes.name: AI Qualify (Gemini)
nodes.notes: Create a Header Auth credential: name = x-goog-api-key, value = your own Gemini API key. Retries once, then falls back to NEEDS_REVIEW.

nodes.name: Parse & Decide
nodes.notes: Validates AI output, then hard rules decide the final priority. AI failure / low confidence / injection / contradiction -> NEEDS_REVIEW.

nodes.name: Store Result
nodes.notes: Demo storage uses workflow static data. Swap for Google Sheets / Airtable / Postgres.

parameters.content:
## AI Lead Qualification & Routing (Demo)
POST a lead to `/webhook/lead-qualification`.

**Validate -> Normalize -> Dedupe -> Rules + AI score -> Route -> Store**

Setup: attach your own Header Auth credential to the Gemini node. No other credentials needed.
Synthetic data only.

### Swap these for real actions
HOT -> Slack / Email / CRM task
WARM -> CRM queue
NEEDS_REVIEW -> review inbox
